pages.title: THE NORTHERN STAR
pages.text: $(bold)"The News They Won't Print"$()$(br)$(italic)Issue #204 (Final)$()$(br2)Editor's Note:$(br2)This is the final issue of The Northern Star Independent. Our printing equipment is frozen solid. I am writing this by hand and will photocopy it at the library, assuming the library still has power.

pages.title: 11 Years of Warnings
pages.text: For eleven years I have published warnings about solar instability and orbital drift. I published 204 issues of this newsletter.$(br2)I was called a "dangerous crank" by a planetary scientist on television. My hard drive was wiped during a DHS visit. My subscriber count dropped from 43 to 12.$(br2)In 2013, NASA quietly revised their orbital mechanics dataset. The revision was consistent with everything I had published since 2003.

pages.title: The Truth Mattered
pages.text: $(italic)I am not writing this to gloat. I am writing this because the truth mattered to me more than anything else in my life, and I need it written down somewhere that I was right.$(br2)Even if no one reads it.$(br2)Especially if no one reads it.$()

pages.title: Cessation Notice
pages.text: $(italic)The Northern Star Independent is ceasing publication.$(br2)Not because I have nothing left to say, but because the ink is freezing in the pen.$()
